MINUTES
  REGULAR MEETING
  OF THE SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL
  MARCH 13, 2019 - 6:00 P.M.

CALL TO ORDER: Mayor Huang called the meeting to order at 6:01 p.m. in the City
Hall Council Chambers, 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE: Mayor Huang led the Pledge of Allegiance.

ROLL CALL  PRESENT: Council Member Jakubowski, Council Member Talt,
  Council Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor
  Huang

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) spoke:
  None.

CITY MANAGER’S REPORT

City Manager Marcella Marlowe provided an update on the state of the City’s operations
over the last month.

MOTION TO WAIVE FURTHER READINGS

Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey moved to waive the reading of the entire text of ordinances
and resolutions; seconded by Council Member Talt. The motion carried unanimously by
the following vote: AYES: Council Member Jakubowski, Council Member Talt, Council
Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor Huang. NOES: None.

CEREMONIAL

1.  PATRIOT AWARD PRESENTATION

Ms. Cassandra Dones presented an award to Police Chief Incontro, Sergeant Cervantes,
and Sergeant Tebbetts on behalf of the National Guard.

CONSENT CALENDAR

Council Member Talt requested that Item 3 be pulled from the Consent Calendar for
discussion.

Council Member Jakubowski moved to adopt the Consent Calendar consisting of items
2, 4, 5, 6, and 7; seconded by Council Member Talt. The motion carried unanimously by
the following vote: AYES: Council Member Jakubowski, Council Member Talt, Council
Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor Huang. NOES: None.
 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
MARCH 13, 2019  PAGE 2 OF 6

CONSENT CALENDAR

2.  RECEIVE AND FILE DISBURSEMENTS REPORT FOR FEBRUARY
  2019

The City Council received and filed the report.

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES

The City Council approved the minutes of the special meeting of February 13, 2019, the
regular meeting of February 13, 2019, and the adjourned regular meeting of February 22,
2019.

5.  AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF SAN
  MARINO AMENDING THE CITY CODE TO PROHIBIT PUBLIC
  URINATION AND DEFECATION; AND AMENDING THE SAN
  MARINO CITY CODE REGARDING THE SAME (2ND READING)

The City Council approved Ordinance No. O-19-1349 on second reading.

6.  APPROVAL FOR THE CITY MANAGER TO TEACH AT THE
  UNIVERSITY OF LA VERNE

The City Council approved the City Manager’s request to teach at the University of La
Verne during its 2019 spring term.

7.  ORDINANCE REGARDING SHARED MOBILITY DEVICES (2ND
  READING) AND RESOLUTION SPECIFYING THE CITY’S EXISTING
  VEHICLE IMPOUND/RELEASE FEE APPLIES TO SHARED
  MOBILITY DEVICES

The City Council adopted Ordinance No. O-19-1348 on second reading and approved
Resolution No. R-19-05.

CONSENT CALENDAR ITEM PULLED FOR DISCUSSION

3.  RECEIVE AND FILE FINANCIAL REPORT AS OF JANUARY 31, 2019

Accounting Manager/Controller Mark Siegfried provided the staff report.

Council Member Talt moved to receive and file the financial report as of January 31, 2019;
seconded by Council Member Ude. The motion passed unanimously by the following vote:
AYES: Council Member Jakubowski, Council Member Talt, Council Member Ude, Vice
Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor Huang. NOES: None.
 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
MARCH 13, 2019  PAGE 3 OF 6

CITY TREASURER’S REPORT

8.  CASH AND INVESTMENT REPORT FOR THE MONTH OF
  JANUARY 2019

The City Council received and filed the Cash and Investment Report for the month of
January 2019.

NEW BUSINESS

9.  AWARD OF A 4-YEAR CONSTRUCTION AGREEMENT FOR THE
  MULTI-YEAR SIDEWALK REPLACEMENT PROGRAM PROJECT
  NO. 18-9272 AND THE FIRST YEAR CONTRACT AMOUNT OF
  $338,710 TO FS CONTRACTORS OF SYLMAR

Parks and Public Works Director Michael Throne provided the staff report.

Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey moved to 1) approve the plans and specifications for the
Multi-Year Sidewalk Replacement Program Project No. 18-9272, 2) award a 4-year
construction agreement including the bid alternate to FS Contractors, Inc., of Sylmar for
the Multi-Year Sidewalk Replacement Program Project No. 18-9272 and approve the first
year contract amount not-to-exceed $338,710, 3) authorize the Parks and Public Works
Director to approve contract change orders if warranted in a cumulative amount not-to-
exceed 5 percent of each year’s contract amount, and 4) appropriate $90,650 from the
Capital Improvement Fund Reserves and add it to the project budget; seconded by
Council Member Jakubowski. Following a roll call, the motion carried unanimously by the
following vote: AYES: Council Member Jakubowski, Council Member Talt, Council
Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor Huang. NOES: None.

10.  APPROVAL OF CHANGE IN CITY’S BANKING RELATIONSHIP

Accounting Manager/Controller Mark Siegfried provided the staff report.

Council Member Talt moved to approve the City’s use of banking services from East West
Bank and direct the City Manager, Interim Finance Director, and Treasurer to take such
actions as are necessary and convenient to establish such services; seconded by Council
Member Ude. The motion carried unanimously by the following vote: AYES: Council
Member Jakubowski, Council Member Talt, Council Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, and Mayor Huang. NOES: None.

11.  REQUEST TO APPROPRIATE $10,000 FOR DNA & LAB SERVICES

Police Commander Aaron Blondé provided the staff report.

Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey moved to authorize a budget amendment and appropriate
funds from the Public Safety Fund Reserves in the amount of $10,000.00 for Other
Contract Services Account #103-30-4150-0000; seconded by Council Member Talt.
 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
MARCH 13, 2019  PAGE 4 OF 6

Following a roll call, the motion passed unanimously by the following vote: AYES: Council
Member Jakubowski, Council Member Talt, Council Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd
Romey, and Mayor Huang. NOES: None.

PUBLIC HEARING

12.  APPEAL FOR MODIFICATION TO CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT
  CUP94-22 AND VARIANCE V96-15 2265 HUNTINGTON DRIVE, (KT
  ENTERPRISES/STARBUCKS)

Planning and Building Director Aldo Cervantes provided the staff report.

Mayor Huang opened the public hearing at 6:51p.m.

The following person(s) spoke:
Hector and Linda Gutierrez, Appellants (provided handouts)
Keith Glassman, Glassman Planning Associates, Inc.
Josh Toerijes, Starbucks District Manager
Jenelle Argueta, Starbucks Manager
Joyce Gatsoulis, San Marino (provided handouts)

Mayor Huang closed the public hearing at 7:20 p.m.

Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey moved to set the matter for a new de novo hearing within
forty (40) days at which time new evidence may be presented and heard; seconded by
Council Member Jakubowski. Following a roll call, the motion passed by the following
vote: AYES: Council Member Jakubowski, Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor
Huang. NOES: Council Member Talt and Council Member Ude.

Mayor Huang recessed the meeting at 7:30 p.m. and reconvened the meeting at 7:38 p.m.

13.  CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE O-19-1350, APPROVING ZONE
  CHANGE NO. ZC17-01 TO REZONE 375 HUNTINGTON DRIVE
  FROM R-1 TO C-1 AND ADOPT A NEGATIVE DECLARATION
  REGARDING THE SAME

Planning and Building Director Aldo Cervantes provided the staff report.

Mayor Huang opened the public hearing at 8:09 p.m.

The following person(s) spoke:
Tom Siciliano, Applicant
Hector and Linda Gutierrez, Appellants

Mayor Huang closed the public hearing at 8:16 p.m.
 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
MARCH 13, 2019  PAGE 5 OF 6

Council Member Talt moved to continue agenda item 13 to the regularly scheduled April
10, 2019 City Council meeting; seconded by Council Member Jakubowski. The motion
passed unanimously by the following vote: AYES: Council Member Jakubowski, Council
Member Talt, Council Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor Huang.
NOES: None.

14.  THE CITY OF SAN MARINO HOUSING ELEMENT ANNUAL
  PROGRESS REPORT FOR THE 2018 CALENDAR YEAR

Planning and Building Director Aldo Cervantes provided the staff report.

Mayor Huang opened public hearing at 8:25 p.m.

The following person(s) spoke:
None.

Mayor Huang closed the public hearing at 8:25 p.m.

Council Member Talt moved to receive and file the 2018 Housing Element Annual
Progress Report and authorize staff to file the report with the Office of Planning and
Research (OPR) and the Department of Housing and Community Development (HCD)
by the April 1, 2019 Deadline; seconded by Council Member Ude. The motion carried
unanimously by the following vote: AYES: Council Member Jakubowski, Council Member
Talt, Council Member Ude, Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey, and Mayor Huang. NOES:
None.

Vice Mayor Shepherd Romey left the meeting at 8:26 p.m. and returned at 8:27 p.m.

WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTED

None.

COUNCIL REPORTS

None.

CITY COUNCIL CALENDAR

City Manager Marcella Marlowe announced that there will be three special meetings in
the Crowell Public Library – Barth Room on the following dates and times: Wednesday,
March 20, 2019 at 3:00 p.m., Wednesday, March 27, 2019 at 8:00 a.m., and Monday, April
1, 2019 at 3:00 p.m.

PUBLIC COMMENTS

The following person(s) spoke:
None.
 CITY COUNCIL MINUTES  REGULAR MEETING
MARCH 13, 2019  PAGE 6 OF 6

Mayor Huang adjourned the meeting at 8:28 p.m.

CLOSED SESSION

The City Council recessed to closed session at 8:30 p.m. to discuss the following:

1.  CONFERENCE WITH REAL PROPERTY  NEGOTIATOR  –
  GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.8:

 Property:  1700 Huntington Drive (Parking
  Lot)
 City Negotiator:  Marcella Marlowe, Ph.D., City
  Manager
 Negotiating Parties:  The City of San Marino
  (“Buyer/Lessee”) and the San
  Marino Unified School District
 (“Seller/Leaser”) Under  Price and terms of payment
 Negotiation:

RECONVENE TO OPEN SESSION

The City Council reconvened to open session at 8:35 p.m.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

The City Attorney announced there was no reportable action.

ADJOURNMENT

The meeting was adjourned at 8:35 p.m.
  _____________________
  AMANDA FOWLER
  ACTING CITY CLERK
